chapter.colophon_sa: इति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासु उपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे अर्जुनविषादयोगः नाम 1ोऽध्यायः ॥ 1 ॥

verses.speaker: dhritarashtra
verses.deva:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।

मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।1.1।।
verses.iast:
dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca

dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ|

māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya||1.1||
verses.en: Tell me, O Sanjaya! Assembled on Kurukshetra, the centre of religious activity, desirous to fight, what indeed did my people and the Pândavas do?

verses.speaker: sanjaya
verses.deva:
सञ्जय उवाच

दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा।

आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.2।।
verses.iast:
sañjaya uvāca

dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṃ vyūḍhaṃ duryodhanastadā|

ācāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vacanamabravīt||1.2||
verses.en: But then King Duryodhana, having seen the Pândava forces in battle-array, approached his teacher Drona, and spoke these words:

verses.deva:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्।

व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता।।1.3।।
verses.iast:
paśyaitāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāmācārya mahatīṃ camūm|

vyūḍhāṃ drupadaputreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā||1.3||
verses.en: "Behold, O Teacher! this mighty army of the sons of Pându, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy gifted pupil.

verses.deva:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि।

युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः।।1.4।।
verses.iast:
atra śūrā maheṣvāsā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi|

yuyudhāno virāṭaśca drupadaśca mahārathaḥ||1.4||
verses.en: "Here (are) heroes, mighty archers, the equals in battle of Bhima and Arjuna—the great warriors Yuyudhâna, Virâta, Drupada; the valiant Dhrishtaketu, Chekitâna and the king of Kâshi; the best of men, Purujit, Kunti-Bhoja and Shaivya; the powerful Yudhâmanyu, and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadrâ, and the sons of Draupadi,—lords of great chariots.

word_meanings.meaning: warriors who could single handedly match the strength of ten thousand ordinary warriors

verses.deva:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्।

पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः।।1.5।।
verses.iast:
dhṛṣṭaketuścekitānaḥ kāśirājaśca vīryavān|

purujitkuntibhojaśca śaibyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ||1.5||
verses.en: "Here (are) heroes, mighty archers, the equals in battle of Bhima and Arjuna—the great warriors Yuyudhâna, Virâta, Drupada; the valiant Dhrishtaketu, Chekitâna and the king of Kâshi; the best of men, Purujit, Kunti-Bhoja and Shaivya; the powerful Yudhâmanyu, and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadrâ, and the sons of Draupadi,—lords of great chariots.

verses.deva:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्।

सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः।।1.6।।
verses.iast:
yudhāmanyuśca vikrānta uttamaujāśca vīryavān|

saubhadro draupadeyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ||1.6||
verses.en: "Here (are) heroes, mighty archers, the equals in battle of Bhima and Arjuna—the great warriors Yuyudhâna, Virâta, Drupada; the valiant Dhrishtaketu, Chekitâna and the king of Kâshi; the best of men, Purujit, Kunti-Bhoja and Shaivya; the powerful Yudhâmanyu, and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadrâ, and the sons of Draupadi,—lords of great chariots.

word_meanings.meaning: warriors who could single handedly match the strength of ten thousand ordinary warriors

verses.deva:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम।

नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते।।1.7।।
verses.iast:
asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama|

nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te||1.7||
verses.en: "Hear also, O Best of the twice-born! the names of those who (are) distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army. These I relate (to you) for your information.

verses.deva:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः।

अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च।।1.8।।
verses.iast:
bhavānbhīṣmaśca karṇaśca kṛpaśca samitiñjayaḥ|

aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca saumadattistathaiva ca||1.8||
verses.en: "Yourself and Bhishma and Karna and Kripa, the victorious in war. Asvatthâmâ and Vikarna and Jayadratha, the son of Somadatta.

verses.deva:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः।

नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।।1.9।।
verses.iast:
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ|

nānāśastrapraharaṇāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ||1.9||
verses.en: "And many other heroes also, well-skilled in fight, and armed with many kinds of weapons, are here, determined to lay down their lives for my sake.

word_meanings.meaning: prepared to lay down their lives
equipped with various kinds of weapons
skilled in the art of warfare

verses.deva:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्।

पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्।।1.10।।
verses.iast:
aparyāptaṃ tadasmākaṃ balaṃ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam|

paryāptaṃ tvidameteṣāṃ balaṃ bhīmābhirakṣitam||1.10||
verses.en: "This our army defended by Bhishma (is) impossible to be counted, but that army of theirs, defended by Bhima (is) easy to number.

verses.deva:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः।

भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि।।1.11।।
verses.iast:
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathābhāgamavasthitāḥ|

bhīṣmamevābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi||1.11||
verses.en: "(Now) do, being stationed in your proper places in the divisions of the army, support Bhishma alone."

verses.deva:
तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः।

सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्।।1.12।।
verses.iast:
tasya saṃjanayanharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ|

siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān||1.12||
verses.en: That powerful, oldest of the Kurus, Bhishma the grandsire, in order to cheer Duryodhana, now sounded aloud a lion-roar and blew his conch.

word_meanings.meaning: the grand old man of the Kuru dynasty (Bheeshma)

verses.deva:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः।

सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्।।1.13।।
verses.iast:
tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ|

sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śabdastumulo'bhavat||1.13||
verses.en: Then following Bhishma, conches and kettle-drums, tabors, trumpets and cowhorns blared forth suddenly from the Kaurava side and the noise was tremendous.

verses.deva:
ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ।

माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः।।1.14।।
verses.iast:
tataḥ śvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau|

mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaścaiva divyau śaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ||1.14||
verses.en: Then, also, Mâdhava and Pândava, stationed in their magnificent chariot yoked with white horses, blew their divine conches with a furious noise.

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the husband of the goddess of fortune, Lakshmi

verses.deva:
पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः।

पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः।।1.15।।
verses.iast:
pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśo devadattaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ|

pauṇḍraṃ dadhmau mahāśaṅkhaṃ bhīmakarmā vṛkodaraḥ||1.15||
verses.en: Hrishikesha blew the Pânchajanya, Dhananjaya, the Devadatta, and Vrikodara, the doer of terrific deeds, his large conch Paundra.

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the Lord of the mind and senses

verses.deva:
अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।

नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ।।1.16।।
verses.iast:
anantavijayaṃ rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ|

nakulaḥ sahadevaśca sughoṣamaṇipuṣpakau||1.16||
verses.en: King Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, blew the conch named Anantavijaya, and Nakula and Sahadeva, their Sughosha and Manipushpaka.

word_meanings.meaning: the conche shells named Sughosh and Manipushpak

verses.deva:
काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः।

धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः।।1.17।।
verses.iast:
kāśyaśca parameṣvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ|

dhṛṣṭadyumno virāṭaśca sātyakiścāparājitaḥ||1.17||
verses.en: The expert bowman, king of Kâshi, and the great warrior Shikhandi, Dhrishtadyumna and Virâta and the unconquered Sâtyaki;

word_meanings.meaning: warriors who could single handedly match the strength of ten thousand ordinary warriors

verses.deva:
द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते।

सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्।।1.18।।
verses.iast:
drupado draupadeyāśca sarvaśaḥ pṛthivīpate|

saubhadraśca mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthak||1.18||
verses.en: O Lord of Earth! Drupada and the sons of Draupadi, and the mighty-armed son of Subhadrâ, all, also blew each his own conch.

verses.deva:
स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्।

नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्।।1.19।।
verses.iast:
sa ghoṣo dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ hṛdayāni vyadārayat|

nabhaśca pṛthivīṃ caiva tumulo vyanunādayan||1.19||
verses.en: And the terrific noise resounding throughout heaven and earth rent the hearts of Dhritarâshtra's party.

verses.deva:
अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः।

प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः।।1.20।।
verses.iast:
atha vyavasthitān dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrānkapidhvajaḥ|

pravṛtte śastrasaṃpāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ||1.20||
verses.en: Then, O Lord of Earth, seeing Dhritarâshtra's party standing marshalled and the shooting about to begin, that Pândava whose ensign was the monkey, raising his bow, said the following words to Krishna:

verses.speaker: arjuna
verses.deva:
अर्जुन उवाच

हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत।।1.21।।
verses.iast:
arjuna uvāca

hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadā vākyamidamāha mahīpate|

senayorubhayormadhye rathaṃ sthāpaya me'cyuta||1.21||
verses.en: Place my chariot, O Achyuta! between the two armies that I may see those who stand here prepared for war. On this eve of battle (let me know) with whom I have to fight.

verses.deva:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्।

कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे।।1.22।।
verses.iast:
yāvadetānnirīkṣe'haṃ yoddhukāmānavasthitān|

kairmayā saha yoddhavyamasminraṇasamudyame||1.22||
verses.en: Place my chariot, O Achyuta! between the two armies that I may see those who stand here prepared for war. On this eve of battle (let me know) with whom I have to fight.

verses.deva:
योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः।

धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः।।1.23।।
verses.iast:
yotsyamānānavekṣe'haṃ ya ete'tra samāgatāḥ|

dhārtarāṣṭrasya durbuddheryuddhe priyacikīrṣavaḥ||1.23||
verses.en: For I desire to observe those who are assembled here for fight, wishing to please the evil-minded Duryodhana by taking his side on this battle-field.

word_meanings.meaning: those who have come to fight

verses.speaker: sanjaya
verses.deva:
संजय उवाच

एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत।

सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्।।1.24।।
verses.iast:
saṃjaya uvāca

evamukto hṛṣīkeśo guḍākeśena bhārata|

senayorubhayormadhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam||1.24||
verses.en: Commanded thus by Gudâkesha, Hrishikesha, O Bhârata, drove that grandest of chariots to a place between the two hosts, facing Bhishma, Drona and all the rulers of the earth, and then spoke thus, "Behold, O Pârtha, all the Kurus gathered together!"

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the Lord of the senses
by Arjun, the conqueror of sleep

verses.deva:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्।

उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति।।1.25।।
verses.iast:
bhīṣmadroṇapramukhataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām|

uvāca pārtha paśyaitānsamavetānkurūniti||1.25||
verses.en: Commanded thus by Gudâkesha, Hrishikesha, O Bhârata, drove that grandest of chariots to a place between the two hosts, facing Bhishma, Drona and all the rulers of the earth, and then spoke thus, "Behold, O Pârtha, all the Kurus gathered together!"

verses.deva:
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्।

आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा।।1.26।।
verses.iast:
tatrāpaśyatsthitānpārthaḥ pitṛ़natha pitāmahān|

ācāryānmātulānbhrātṛ़nputrānpautrānsakhīṃstathā||1.26||
verses.en: Then saw Pârtha stationed there in both the armies, grandfathers, fathers-in-law and uncles, brothers and cousins, his own and their sons and grandsons, and comrades, teachers, and other friends as well.

verses.deva:
श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि।

तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्।।1.27।।
verses.iast:
śvaśurānsuhṛdaścaiva senayorubhayorapi|

tānsamīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvānbandhūnavasthitān||1.27||
verses.en: Then he, the son of Kunti, seeing all those kinsmen stationed in their ranks, spoke thus sorrowfully, filled with deep compassion.

verses.speaker: arjuna
verses.deva:
अर्जुन उवाच

कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्।

दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्।।1.28।।
verses.iast:
arjuna uvāca

kṛpayā parayā''viṣṭo viṣīdannidamabravīt|

dṛṣṭvemaṃ svajanaṃ kṛṣṇa yuyutsuṃ samupasthitam||1.28||
verses.en: Arjuna said: Seeing these my kinsmen, O Krishna, eager for fight, my limbs fail and my mouth is parched.

verses.deva:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।

वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते।।1.29।।
verses.iast:
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati|

vepathuśca śarīre me romaharṣaśca jāyate||1.29||
verses.en: Seeing, O Krishna, these my kinsmen gathered here, eager for fight, my limbs fail me, and my mouth is parched up. I shiver all over, and my hair stands on end. The bow Gândiva slips from my hand, and my skin burns.

word_meanings.meaning: standing of bodily hair on end

verses.deva:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते।

न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः।।1.30।।
verses.iast:
gāṇḍīvaṃ sraṃsate hastāttvakcaiva paridahyate|

na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ||1.30||
verses.en: Neither, O Keshava, can I stand upright. My mind is in a whirl. And I see adverse omens.

verses.deva:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव।

न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे।।1.31।।
verses.iast:
nimittāni ca paśyāmi viparītāni keśava|

na ca śreyo'nupaśyāmi hatvā svajanamāhave||1.31||
verses.en: Neither, O Krishna, do I see any good in killing these my own people in battle. I desire neither victory nor empire, nor yet pleasure.

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, killer of the Keshi demon

verses.deva:
न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च।

किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा।।1.32।।
verses.iast:
na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca|

kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā||1.32||
verses.en: Of what avail is dominion to us, of what avail are pleasures and even life, if these, O Govinda! for whose sake it is desired that empire, enjoyment and pleasure should be ours, themselves stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth—Teachers, uncles, sons and also grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, besides other kinsmen.

word_meanings.meaning: Krishna, he who gives pleasure to the senses, he who is fond of cows

verses.deva:
येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।

त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च।।1.33।।
verses.iast:
yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca|

ta ime'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca||1.33||
verses.en: Of what avail is dominion to us, of what avail are pleasures and even life, if these, O Govinda! for whose sake it is desired that empire, enjoyment and pleasure should be ours, themselves stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth—Teachers, uncles, sons and also grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, besides other kinsmen.

verses.deva:
आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः।

मातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा।।1.34।।
verses.iast:
ācāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrāstathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ|

mātulāḥ ścaśurāḥ pautrāḥ śyālāḥ sambandhinastathā||1.34||
verses.en: Of what avail is dominion to us, of what avail are pleasures and even life, if these, O Govinda! for whose sake it is desired that empire, enjoyment and pleasure should be ours, themselves stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth—Teachers, uncles, sons and also grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, besides other kinsmen.

verses.deva:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन।

अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते।।1.35।।
verses.iast:
etānna hantumicchāmi ghnato'pi madhusūdana|

api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte||1.35||
verses.en: Even though these were to kill me, O slayer of Madhu, I could not wish to kill them, not even for the sake of dominion over the three worlds, how much less for the sake of the earth!

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, killer of the demon Madhu

verses.deva:
निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।

पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः।।1.36।।
verses.iast:
nihatya dhārtarāṣṭrānnaḥ kā prītiḥ syājjanārdana|

pāpamevāśrayedasmānhatvaitānātatāyinaḥ||1.36||
verses.en: What pleasure indeed could be ours, O Jnanârdana, from killing these sons of Dhritarâshtra? Sin only could take hold of us by the slaying of these felons.

word_meanings.meaning: he who looks after the public, Shree Krishna

verses.deva:
तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्।

स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव।।1.37।।
verses.iast:
tasmānnārhā vayaṃ hantuṃ dhārtarāṣṭrānsvabāndhavān|

svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava||1.37||
verses.en: Therefore ought we not to kill our kindred, the sons of Dhritarâshtra. For how could we, O Mâdhava, gain happiness by the slaying of our own kinsmen?

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the husband of Yogmaya

verses.deva:
यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्।।1.38।।
verses.iast:
yadyapyete na paśyanti lobhopahatacetasaḥ|

kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mitradrohe ca pātakam||1.38||
verses.en: Though these, with understanding overpowered by greed, see no evil due to decay of families, and no sin in hostility to friends, why should we, O Janârdana, who see clearly the evil due to the decay of families, not turn away from this sin?

verses.deva:
कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।

कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन।।1.39।।
verses.iast:
kathaṃ na jñeyamasmābhiḥ pāpādasmānnivartitum|

kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ prapaśyadbhirjanārdana||1.39||
verses.en: Though these, with understanding overpowered by greed, see no evil due to decay of families, and no sin in hostility to friends, why should we, O Janârdana, who see clearly the evil due to the decay of families, not turn away from this sin?

word_meanings.meaning: he who looks after the public, Shree Krishna

verses.deva:
कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः।

धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत।।1.40।।
verses.iast:
kulakṣaye praṇaśyanti kuladharmāḥ sanātanāḥ|

dharme naṣṭe kulaṃ kṛtsnamadharmo'bhibhavatyuta||1.40||
verses.en: On the decay of a family the immemorial religious rites of that family die out. On the destruction of spirituality, impiety further overwhelms the whole of the family.

word_meanings.meaning: in the destruction of a dynasty

verses.deva:
अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः।

स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः।।1.41।।
verses.iast:
adharmābhibhavātkṛṣṇa praduṣyanti kulastriyaḥ|

strīṣu duṣṭāsu vārṣṇeya jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ||1.41||
verses.en: On the prevalence of impiety, O Krishna, the women of the family become corrupt; and women being corrupted, there arises, O Vârshneya, intermingling of castes.

verses.deva:
सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च।

पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः।।1.42।।
verses.iast:
saṅkaro narakāyaiva kulaghnānāṃ kulasya ca|

patanti pitaro hyeṣāṃ luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ||1.42||
verses.en: Admixture of castes, indeed, is for the hell of the family and the destroyers of the family; their ancestors fall, deprived of the offerings of rice-ball and water.

word_meanings.meaning: for those who destroy the family

verses.deva:
दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः।

उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः।।1.43।।
verses.iast:
doṣairetaiḥ kulaghnānāṃ varṇasaṅkarakārakaiḥ|

utsādyante jātidharmāḥ kuladharmāśca śāśvatāḥ||1.43||
verses.en: By these misdeeds of the destroyers of the family, bringing about confusion of castes, are the immemorial religious rites of the caste and the family destroyed.

word_meanings.meaning: of those who destroy the family

verses.deva:
उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन।

नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम।।1.44।।
verses.iast:
utsannakuladharmāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ janārdana|

narake'niyataṃ vāso bhavatītyanuśuśruma||1.44||
verses.en: We have heard, O Janârdana, that inevitable is the dwelling in hell of those men in whose families religious practices have been destroyed.

word_meanings.meaning: he who looks after the public, Shree Krishna
I have heard from the learned

verses.deva:
अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।

यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः।।1.45।।
verses.iast:
aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam|

yadrājyasukhalobhena hantuṃ svajanamudyatāḥ||1.45||
verses.en: Alas, we are involved in a great sin, in that we are prepared to slay our kinsmen, from greed of the pleasures of a kingdom!

word_meanings.meaning: driven by the desire for kingly pleasure

verses.deva:
यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः।

धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्।।1.46।।
verses.iast:
yadi māmapratīkāramaśastraṃ śastrapāṇayaḥ|

dhārtarāṣṭrā raṇe hanyustanme kṣemataraṃ bhavet||1.46||
verses.en: Verily, if the sons of Dhritarâshtra, weapons in hand, were to slay me, unresisting and unarmed, in the battle, that would be better for me.

verses.speaker: sanjaya
verses.deva:
सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।

विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः।।1.47।।
verses.iast:
sañjaya uvāca

evamuktvā'rjunaḥ saṃkhye rathopastha upāviśat|

visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ||1.47||
verses.en: Speaking thus in the midst of the battle-field, Arjuna casting away his bow and arrows, sank down on the seat of his chariot, with his mind distressed with sorrow.
